notes.title: Update on state of the game!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've been hard at work on tech corp have a bunch of new changes to announce. 

Some of these changes include New UI style, new gameplay mechanics, and new products that you will be able to create,  A new build is coming out on Feb 22nd that you can playtest on.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33386184/d0851cb23b4f5413a7fef157720fda7a9e9ba18f.jpg


The current planned release date is April 16th. Also there have been some posts about our website saying you could buy it. Our website has been setup as placeholder when we got it designed, so we could launch. The game never been up for sale yet and won't be until April. We have no plans for any further delay, and we promise the wait will be worth it!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33386184/25332f667f8ba1d0b45703323d64502b527d76e9.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33386184/b252fbaf129b1aff1a57ffa58394af3ce05d20b8.jpg



For those who wish to join the test next week. Please join  our discord:
https://discord.gg/4fjAK2v
